mobbin:c89738be-2928-4ed1-94ac-f730f0426.summary: On 'Check In Guests', tapping a checked-in guest's checkmark opens 'Uncheck them?'; confirming 'Undo check-in' returns them to a 'Check in' button like unchecked guests.
steps: Check In Guests: checked vs Check in
List after undo: both show Check in
steal: A filled checkmark versus outlined 'Check in' (screen 1) makes presence readable without opening a card.
A confirm titled 'Uncheck them?' shows the guest avatar and name before 'Undo check-in' (screen 2), so reversing a tag is deliberate.
'Nevermind' sits beside 'Undo' (screen 2), so accidental taps can be cancelled safely.
Search 'Find a guest…' above the list (screen 1) scales when many learners are on the roster.
avoid: Reply-to-invitation (RSVP) emoji lines such as Going or Maybe (screens 1-3) set a party tone; sim rooms need role or group instead.
mobbin:c89738be-2928-4ed1-94ac-f730f0426.fit: Recording: adds confirm-before-untag for room check-in outside the SRV so wrong learner tags can be reversed without rewriting Annotation or transcript speaker labels by hand.
